answer: A bond is refunded only after 11 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The harbor counter is kept in pigment and quill publishes each reset. An adversary hence has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 11 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Each duplicate costs another 24 dollars in locked collateral and another 9 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
